create_teleflm_model: create a TeleFLMModel instance with LlamaConfig and optional QuantizationConfig for inference
initialize_teleflm_for_causal_lm: initialize a TeleFLMForCausalLM model with LlamaConfig and optional quantization config
run_teleflm_forward_pass: run a forward pass on TeleFLMModel with input_ids, positions, and ForwardBatch for generation
enable_mup_scaling: enable mup scaling on TeleFLMForCausalLM by setting input_mult, output_mult, and logit_scale from config
init_teleflm_model_instance: init a TeleFLMModel instance via TeleFLMForCausalLM._init_model with config and quant_config
